'''Astrogation datacards''' were [[Datacard/Legends|datacards]] used for storage of data having to do with [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]]. One such datacard contained [[Bshrah-Ky-Ushsj]]'s information on [[System VV-99-7JE-2N71]].
